articles.headline: Join OSPOlogy + OSPO Summit China 2026 in Shanghai
articles.dek: The CNCF blog says you can still register for the Shanghai OSPO summit—here’s the practical rundown.

body.text: Key Takeaway

You can still sign up for the OSPOlogy + OSPO Summit China happening in Shanghai, and the event will ship recorded sessions to YouTube after it ends[FACT:fc10e2481e308c1e4bef0e550a70990d][FACT:fcd99944f48d22b260a7c0873b4c50ba].
Why This Matters

Open‑source program managers in the Kubernetes ecosystem need to keep up with how OSPOs are turning into “agentic” organizations that steer cloud‑native roadmaps[FACT:520122fde867a6ff770a34a418323570][FACT:c85f5355940f61a90ddecd6249a91ed3]. Missing the talk means you might overlook emerging governance tricks that affect your stack.
What Happened

CNCF posted the announcement on Sep 3 2026, confirming the summit will run in Shanghai and that seats are allocated on a first‑come‑first‑served basis[FACT:2933a3a9ab269c2061bf5f9e8339be3a][FACT:fc10e2481e308c1e4bef0e550a70990d].
Builder View

If you’re building Kubernetes platforms, block a half‑day to attend the schedule that mixes OSPO strategy with hands‑on cloud‑native case studies[FACT:3facc31bdf7157c2006c10c626b5c699][FACT:709981cc9554394743d6f2021e36c600]. You can also replay any missed session on the CNCF YouTube channel, so the time‑investment stays flexible[FACT:fcd99944f48d22b260a7c0873b4c50ba].
Open Questions

The agenda still lacks a detailed speaker list, pricing tiers for non‑CNCF members, and how the summit will integrate with existing K8s SIG meetings[FACT:8ac4f0630318717caf46dd9bd884d89d]. We’ll need clarification before we can map the content to our sprint planning.
Ardur Take

From an Ardur standpoint, the summit is a solid opportunity to sync OSPO expectations with your cloud‑native delivery pipeline, but treat the details as provisional until the full program drops[FACT:c85f5355940f61a90ddecd6249a91ed3][FACT:8ac4f0630318717caf46dd9bd884d89d].

keyPoints: Registration for the Shanghai OSPOlogy + OSPO Summit China 2026 remains open.
Seats are allocated on a first‑come‑first‑served basis; plan your day early.
All sessions will be recorded and posted to the CNCF YouTube channel.
The summit targets Open Source Program Management evolution and emerging cloud‑native topics.
articles.whyItMatters: OSPO leaders and Kubernetes builders alike need to understand how open‑source program strategies are evolving, because those decisions filter down to the tooling and governance that shape your cloud‑native workloads.
articles.readerAction: Visit the CNCF blog post, grab a ticket while seats last, and add the event schedule to your calendar; then bookmark the CNCF YouTube channel for the recordings.
